Build an interactive 2D figure from the brief below and the source image.

AUTHORED FIGURE BRIEF:
This figure shows a color-coded periodic table of the elements annotated with the most common ionic charges formed by main-group and selected transition-metal elements, illustrating the relationship between an element's position in the table and its tendency to form ions. Group 1 elements (Li+, Na+, K+, Rb+, Cs+, Fr+, shaded purple) and Group 2 elements (Be2+, Mg2+, Ca2+, Sr2+, Ba2+, Ra2+, shaded green) form cations with charges equal to their group number, while nonmetals in Groups 15–17 (shaded pink) form anions such as N3−, O2−, F−, P3−, S2−, Cl−, and their congeners, with negative charges reflecting how many groups they lie to the left of the noble gases. Transition metals in the central d-block (shaded tan) display variable charges — for example Cr3+/Cr6+, Fe2+/Fe3+, Cu+/Cu2+, and Au+/Au3+ — demonstrating that their ionic behavior is not reliably predicted by group position alone. Noble gases (He, Ne, Ar, Kr, Xe, Rn, shaded blue) carry no charge label, reflecting their chemical inertness. This figure establishes the periodic trends in ion formation and marks the boundary where the group-number rule reliably predicts ionic charge versus where transition-metal variability and other exceptions require additional consideration.

REQUESTED INTERACTIONS:
- Click any element cell: highlight it and display the ion charge, the electron configuration, and the group-trend rule that explains the charge
- Slider for group number (1-18): sweep across the table highlighting one column at a time and showing the typical ion formed for each group
- Toggle the color scheme: switch between element-type coloring (metals, nonmetals, noble gases) and charge-value coloring to compare the two classification schemes

SOURCE FILE: OpenStax Chemistry 2e, chapter 2

There is no blueprint: decide the figure type, elements, labels, controls, and any step sequence yourself.

}); // Title draw.text("Periodic Table of the Elements") .cx(SVG_W / 2).y(10) .font({family: 'sans-serif', size: 18, weight: 'bold', fill: '#111'}); // Axes Labels for (let g = 1; g <= 18; g++) { draw.text(g.toString()) .cx(X0 + (g - 1) * (CELL_W + GAP) + CELL_W / 2).y(Y0 - 24) .font({family: 'sans-serif', size: 12, fill: '#1b4f72', weight: 'bold', anchor: 'middle'}); } draw.text("Group").cx(X0 + CELL_W / 2).y(Y0 - 42) .font({family: 'sans-serif', size: 13, fill: '#1b4f72', weight: 'bold', anchor: 'middle'}); for (let p = 1; p <= 7; p++) { draw.text(p.toString()) .x(X0 - 16).cy(Y0 + (p - 1) * (CELL_H + GAP) + CELL_H / 2) .font({family: 'sans-serif', size: 12, fill: '#4a235a', weight: 'bold', anchor: 'end'}); const textNode = group.text(function(add) { lines.forEach(function(line, i) { let base = '', sub = '', space = '', sup = ''; if (line === 'Hg2 2+') { base = 'Hg'; sub = '2'; space = ' '; sup = '2+'; } else if (line === '*' || line === '**') { base = line; } else { let m = line.match(/^([A-Za-z]+)(\d*)([\s]*)([\d]*[+-]?)$/); if (m) { base = m[1]; sub = m[2]; space = m[3]; sup = m[4]; } else { base = line; } } let ts = add.tspan(base); if (i === 0) { ts.x(cx); } else { ts.dy('1.2em').x(cx); } if (sub) { add.tspan(sub).font({size: '0.65em'}).dy(5); add.tspan('').dy(-5); } if (space) add.tspan(space); if (sup) { add.tspan(sup).font({size: '0.7em'}).dy(-6); add.tspan('').dy(6); } }); }); textNode.font({family: 'sans-serif', size: 13, anchor: 'middle'}); let yOffset = lines.length > 1 ? -12 : -7; textNode.cx(cx).y(cy + yOffset); return textNode; } // Render cells const cellElements = []; let rule = gRules[d.actualG] || ''; let charge = d.ch; if (charge === 'var') charge = 'Variable'; else if (charge !== null && charge > 0) charge = '+' + charge; let cleanRule = rule.replace(//g, '').replace(/<\/b>/g, ''); let body = `Typical Charge: ${charge}\nConfiguration: ${conf}\n\n${cleanRule}`; showPopup(`${d.label.replace(/\n/g, ' / ')} Ion`, body); } else { let cleanRule = (gRules[d.actualG] || 'No typical ion shown for this block.').replace(//g, '').replace(/<\/b>/g, ''); showPopup(`Group ${d.actualG}`, cleanRule); } }); }); // Arrow linking Group 3 to Lanthanides const ax = X0 + 2 * (CELL_W + GAP) + CELL_W * 0.4; const ay = Y0 + 7 * (CELL_H + GAP); // Base of Group 3 Period 7 const aMidY = Y0 + 8 * (CELL_H + GAP) + 12; draw.polygon(`${aEx},${aMidY-4} ${aEx+6},${aMidY} ${aEx},${aMidY+4}`).fill('#e74c3c'); // Legends const lX = X0 + 3 * (CELL_W + GAP) + 16; // Starts at Group 4 column const lY = Y0 + 1 * (CELL_H + GAP); // Inside the empty space above transition metals // Type Legend const typeLegendGroup = draw.group(); typeLegendGroup.text("Classification:").move(lX, lY).font({size: 13, weight: 'bold', fill: '#444'}); const typeLData = [ {label: 'Alkali Metal', c: C.G1}, {label: 'Alkaline Earth', c: C.G2}, {label: 'Transition Metal', c: C.TRANS}, {label: 'Other Nonmetal', c: C.NONMET}, {label: 'Halogen', c: C.HALO}, {label: 'Noble Gas', c: C.NOBLE} ]; typeLData.forEach((ld, i) => { let col = i % 3; let row = Math.floor(i / 3); let lx = lX + col * 135; let ly = lY + 22 + row * 24; typeLegendGroup.rect(14, 14).move(lx, ly).fill(ld.c).stroke({color:'#aaa', width:1}); typeLegendGroup.text(ld.label).move(lx + 20, ly - 2).font({size: 12, fill: '#333'}); }); // Charge Legend const chargeLegendGroup = draw.group().hide(); chargeLegendGroup.text("Typical Ionic Charge:").move(lX, lY).font({size: 13, weight: 'bold', fill: '#444'}); const chargeLData = [ {label: '+1', c: CHARGE_C[1]}, {label: '+2', c: CHARGE_C[2]}, {label: '+3', c: CHARGE_C[3]}, {label: 'Var', c: CHARGE_C['var']}, {label: '0', c: CHARGE_C[0]}, {label: '-1', c: CHARGE_C['-1']}, {label: '-2', c: CHARGE_C['-2']}, {label: '-3', c: CHARGE_C['-3']}, {label: '-4', c: CHARGE_C['-4']} ]; chargeLData.forEach((ld, i) => { let col = i % 5; let row = Math.floor(i / 5); let lx = lX + col * 55; let ly = lY + 22 + row * 24; chargeLegendGroup.rect(14, 14).move(lx, ly).fill(ld.c).stroke({color:'#aaa', width:1}); chargeLegendGroup.text(ld.label).move(lx + 20, ly - 2).font({size: 12, fill: '#333'}); }); // Interaction State Variables let currentScheme = 'type'; let highlightGroup = 0; window.update_color = function(scheme) { currentScheme = scheme; if (scheme === 'charge') { typeLegendGroup.hide(); chargeLegendGroup.show(); } else { chargeLegendGroup.hide(); typeLegendGroup.show(); } refreshCells(); }; window.update_group = function(g) { highlightGroup = g; refreshCells(); const infoP = document.getElementById('groupInfoText'); if (g === 0) { infoP.innerHTML = "Select a group using the slider to explore the periodic trends in ion formation."; } else { infoP.innerHTML = gRules[g] || "No prominent trend."; } }; function refreshCells() { cellElements.forEach(d => { let baseColor = C.WHITE; if (currentScheme === 'type') { baseColor = C[d.t]; } else { baseColor = (d.ch === null) ? '#ffffff' : (CHARGE_C[d.ch] || '#ffffff'); } let opacity = 1.0; if (highlightGroup > 0 && d.actualG !== highlightGroup) { opacity = 0.15; } d.rect.fill(baseColor).opacity(opacity); if (d.text) d.text.opacity(opacity); d.rect.stroke({opacity: Math.max(opacity, 0.4)}); }); } // Initial draw hook window.__markRendered(); // @FIGURE_CODE_END
